name: @baboons/ports
description: Scan localhost for running HTTP/HTTPS servers and browse them in a live dashboard

scripts.//build: Cleans first: `cp -R src/ui dist/ui` nests into dist/ui/ui when the target already exists, which silently breaks static serving on a rebuild.
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp -R src/ui dist/ui && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

author: Johan
